title: Use constructor injection with explicit lifetimes
statement: Receive required collaborators through constructor injection, register them with a lifetime justified by their state, and avoid service-location or hidden process-global dependencies.
rationale: Quality Studio review orchestration composes runners, stores, sensors, and registries. Constructor injection makes those dependencies testable while explicit lifetimes prevent cross-run state leakage.

examples.bad: public Task RunAsync() { var registry = Global.Services.GetRequiredService<SensorRegistry>(); return registry.Run(); }
examples.good: public sealed class ReviewJobService(SensorRegistry sensors, ILogger<ReviewJobService> logger) { /* use injected collaborators */ }

history.change: Initial .NET DI seed grounded in Quality Studio service registration and orchestration.
